description: Get all elements and connectors placed on a specific diagram: the `diagram` itself, plus `elements` and `connectors`. `elements` already includes free-text `Note` diagram objects, which often carry a legend or abbreviation definitions an agent would otherwise miss. Connectors include feature-link resolution showing which attribute or operation each end attaches to. The connector list is the union of explicit t_diagramlinks rows and implied connectors (both ends on the diagram).

diagramId.description: The Diagram_ID to get elements for

name: ea_get_diagram_elements
